subject: mathematics
concept: Graphing sine and cosine functions and identifying amplitude and period
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student traces a physical wave pattern generated by unit-circle rotation onto a graph
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a sine or cosine equation to its correctly graphed wave, amplitude, and period
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the amplitude and period of a given sine or cosine function

misconception_flags: confuses amplitude (height of the wave) with period (length of one cycle)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
